title: Volvo FH FUPS Bullbar 6 Post Heavy Duty Road Train Bullbar #36
description: Volvo FH16 Hi-tensile 6 Post Heavy Duty Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection plus 100mm wide uprights. Radar compatible. Custom driving light mounts and indicator repeater/daylight running lights mounted in the external box uprights. Flip over Road Train sign on aluminium plates mounted on main channel. Two sets of Roo slicers and extra small lower pipe extensions plus 12mm Polycarbonate over headlights for maximum protection. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with dual tow pins.
